interfaces: This versatile protocol converter is designed to integrate seamlessly with the Touch10 control pad, enabling the conversion of IP protocols to RS-232, Relay, and IR protocols over a wired LAN. It offers comprehensive control capabilities for various AV and automation devices while providing contact input detection and remote-control options via a network connection.

Offers an Ethernet port for robust network integration, allowing remote control and configuration over a wired connection. Supports Power over Ethernet (PoE), eliminating the need for a separate power supply and simplifying installation.

This versatile protocol converter is designed to integrate seamlessly with the Touch10 control pad, enabling the conversion of IP protocols to RS-232, Relay, and IR protocols over a wired LAN. It offers comprehensive control capabilities for various AV and automation devices while providing contact input detection and remote-control options via a network connection.

Features a dedicated IR TX port for precise infrared device control. Ideal for managing IR-based devices such as TVs, projectors, and AV receivers. The system supports customizable IR commands, allowing users to program specific functions for various devices, enhancing flexibility in AV setups.

Features a dedicated IR TX port for precise infrared device control. Ideal for managing IR-based devices such as TVs, projectors, and AV receivers. The system supports customizable IR commands, allowing users to program specific functions for various devices, enhancing flexibility in AV setups
Includes four relay ports designed for reliable control of relay-based devices, such as projection screens, motorized curtains, and roller shutters.

Offers an Ethernet port for robust network integration, allowing remote control and configuration over a wired connection. Supports Power over Ethernet (PoE), eliminating the need for a separate power supply and simplifying installation.

Fully compatible with the Touch10 control pad offering versatile control and seamless integration with various AV systems. The Touch10 control pad delivers an intuitive, touch-based interface, allowing users to easily control devices
